component.name: HudMod Video Editor
component.summary: Fast open-source video editor built with Godot and FFmpeg

description.p: HudMod is an open-source video editor under the GPLv3 license. It is fast and equipped with advanced tools, developed to fill a gap in the video editing software market, focusing primarily on Linux and a fast workflow.
HudMod uses the Godot engine in the background, and FFmpeg for media decoding and encoding.

ul.li: Effects based on a Components system
An integrated custom interface with Multi-Monitor support
Multi-pass shader pipelines and color grading
FFmpeg export with support for MP4/MKV/AVI/WEBM containers and H.264/H.265/VP8/VP9/AV1/ProRes/FFV1 codecs

description.p: Alpha 2 release of HudMod. First public alpha builds.
